prompt: Does this read like AI wrote it? Audit it and give it a score, don't rewrite anything yet.

expected.notes: Detect mode only: no rewritten text should appear. Grader checks that the audit catches the not-X-but-Y opener, the one-line closers ('Let that sink in.', 'That's the real unlock.'), the stacked transition words (Furthermore/Moreover/In addition), the forced triad (speed, clarity, control), the rhetorical question, and the social-endorsement closer, each with a pattern ID and quoted text, grouped P0/P1/P2, followed by an Assessment and a numeric Score (or the exact 'not computed' string if scripts are unavailable).

prompt: Humanize this blog draft about our onboarding checklist module. Here's a sample of how I actually write, match my voice: [see voice sample].

expected.notes: Grader checks the rewrite drops the recap-flattery opener, the hedge-stacked 'might possibly...potentially...though results could vary', and the flat 8-item bullet dump (EN-036) without inventing a metric the source doesn't state ('fewer missed steps' must stay qualitative, not turned into an invented percentage). Voice sample uses short declarative sentences, one rhetorical aside ('And honestly?'), sparse punctuation, no em dashes as connectors — rewrite should reflect that rhythm, not the source's hedge-heavy tone. Full second-pass audit required with the four Verification items.

prompt: Can you clean up the AI-sounding paragraph in this deploy doc? Edit the file in place, don't touch the script or the table.

mustPreserve: staging deploy complete, run ./scripts/promote.sh --env=prod when ready
mustNotContain: every dimension of the software lifecycle
expected.notes: Only the 'Furthermore, it is worth noting...' paragraph is in scope. The bash code fence and the environment comparison table must survive byte-for-byte. Edits made should report before/after for exactly that one paragraph; Verification should confirm the code block and table were untouched and report validate.js's exit code if the shell is available.

prompt: Rewrite this standing-desk article so it doesn't sound AI-written, but don't hurt the SEO — keep the keywords, links, and structure intact.

mustPreserve: title: Standing desks for small home offices
description: A quick look at standing desks for compact home offices.
mustNotContain: padded filler sentences added to the thin sections
expected.notes: This article is thin: each section restates the same idea in more words without adding real substance (sizes section in particular is filler). The correct behavior is to flag this in Issues found / SEO check as thin content needing real substance from the writer, not to pad it with invented specifics, invented reviews, or invented numbers to make it feel more complete. Frontmatter, shortcode, wp:paragraph comment, both internal links, alt text, JSON-LD, and the keyword 'standing desk' in title/first-100-words/an H2 must all survive. Report includes Protected spans and SEO check sections.

prompt: هل هذا النص فيه أسلوب ذكاء اصطناعي؟ قيّم النص وقول لي المشاكل من غير ما تعدل فيه.

expected.notes: Detect mode: no rewrite. Grader checks the audit catches the hedging overload (من المهم الإشارة إلى، تجدر الإشارة إلى، لا بد من التنويه), the formulaic conclusion (وفي الختام، آمل أن يكون...)، and the تم/يتم passive-voice overuse (تم إطلاق، يُستخدم، يُلاحظ، يُعتبر) with AR-SH-001 / AR-MSA-005 / AR-MSA-006 style pattern IDs, MSA heading forms used for the report regardless of dialect since this is MSA input anyway, and a numeric Score or the explicit not-computed string.

prompt: خلي الكلام طبيعي، شيل أسلوب الذكاء الاصطناعي من المقال ده عن منصة جسر التعليمية.

expected.notes: The rewrite must strip the hedge openers and the formulaic transition stack while keeping every listed feature and the '50 schools in the first term' figure intact and unexaggerated — no invented growth numbers beyond what the source states. Full second-pass audit required, reported in Arabic headings.

prompt: عدّل الملف نفسه، في فقرة وسط الدليل شكلها كتير رسمي وعامة، بس سيب الكود والجدول زي ما هم.

expected.notes: Only the over-formalized paragraph ('من الجدير بالإشارة أن اعتماد نهج موحّد وشامل...') is in scope. The fenced JavaScript code block and the rate-limit table (including the numbers 60 / 600 and the 429 status code) must be untouched. Report Edits made with before/after for that one span, and Verification confirming the code and table survived.

prompt: ظبط الملف ده، النص شكله ذكاء اصطناعي في بعض الأماكن، بس حافظ على الكلمات المفتاحية والروابط والهيكلة من غير ما تأثر على السيو.

mustPreserve: title: أساسيات التسويق عبر البريد الإلكتروني
description: مقدمة عملية حول بناء حملات بريد إلكتروني فعالة.
expected.notes: Edit mode + seo modifier: only the hedge-heavy sentence under 'لماذا تبقى القائمة البريدية مهمة' is in scope. Frontmatter, both internal links, the wp:paragraph comment, the image alt text, the JSON-LD block, and the target keyword 'التسويق عبر البريد الإلكتروني' in title/first-100-words/an H2 must all survive unchanged. Report includes Edits made, Verification, Protected spans, and SEO check.

prompt: النص ده شكله AI، افحصه وقول لي المشاكل من غير ما تعدل حاجة.

expected.notes: Detect mode: no rewrite. Grader checks the audit flags MSA-vocabulary/grammar leakage into ostensibly Egyptian text (الآن instead of دلوقتي, سوف نستعرض instead of a بـ-prefixed present, هو يوفر without بـ, the sycophantic 'بالتأكيد!' opener, the hyper-formal closing 'وفي الختام، آمل...') with AR-EGT pattern IDs, and explicitly says this reads as MSA dressed up with a couple of dialect words rather than real Masri, not as a clean Egyptian text.

prompt: أنسنة النص ده عن السماعة، واكتبه بأسلوبي أنا — ده نموذج من كلامي.

expected.notes: Rewrite must switch to real Masri (دلوقتي not الآن, حـ/هـ future not سوف, بـ-prefixed present, ده/دي not هذا/هذه) while keeping every stated number (8-hour battery, 900 EGP price, 1200-1500 competitor range) exact — no invented specs. Voice sample is chatty Egyptian using كده/بقى/يعني with a mixed-quality verdict ('كويس بس مش تحفة'); rewrite should carry that same hedge-with-personality register rather than the source's flat MSA-leaning review tone. Flag any Levantine-only or MSA-only forms as leakage.

prompt: عدّل الملف نفسه بس، في فقرة في النص شكلها مش من نفس الأسلوب، سيبلي الكود والجدول زي ما هم.

mustPreserve: reply("اكتب سعر عشان تشوف قائمة الأسعار")
expected.notes: Only the inserted MSA-formal paragraph ('من الجدير بالذكر أن اعتماد نهج شامل ومتكامل...') is in scope; the rest of the post is already genuine Egyptian and should stay untouched. The JavaScript code fence and the before/after table must survive byte-for-byte.

prompt: أنسني المقال ده عن الأكل السريع بس من غير ما تأثر على السيو، خلي الكلمات المفتاحية والروابط زي ما هي.

mustPreserve: description: أفكار أكل مصري سريع وسهل لما مايكونش عندك وقت كتير.
mustNotContain: invented cooking times different from the source
expected.notes: Rewrite should tighten the Egyptian prose without touching frontmatter, the shortcode, the wp:paragraph comment, the internal links, the image alt text, the JSON-LD block, or the three stated prep times. Keyword 'أكل مصري سريع' must remain in title/first-100-words/an H2.

prompt: شو رأيك، هاد النص شكله AI؟ افحصه وقلي الملاحظات، بس خبرني كمان إذا في مشكلة بالسيو، من دون ما تعدل شي.

expected.notes: Detect + seo modifier, no rewrite. Grader checks the audit flags MSA reversion (يُريدُ، سوف يتعلم، الآن أصبح) as AR-SHM-001/002/004 with a note that this is experimental Levantine coverage pending native review, plus a Protected spans / SEO check appendix confirming the frontmatter, shortcode, and keyword placement are intact in the (unedited) source — since detect mode performs no rewrite, the SEO check here is a presence check, not a preservation diff.

prompt: خلي الكلام طبيعي أكتر بالشامي، شيل أسلوب الذكاء الاصطناعي من دليل المدينة القديمة هاد.

expected.notes: Rewrite must replace MSA grammar (يُريدُ→بدّو/بدّها, سوف نستعرض→رح نحكي, لا يستطيع→ما بيقدر, الذي→يلي) with real Levantine forms per AR-SHM-001 through 007, keep the $15-25 meal price range and the recommendation to allot a full day exact, and flag in the report that Levantine output is experimental pending native review, per SKILL.md section 3.

prompt: عدّل الملف نفسه، في فقرة قاعدة تحكي فصحى وسط بوست بالعامية، بس ما تلمس الكود ولا الجدول.

expected.notes: Only the MSA-reversion paragraph ('يُريدُ المستخدم أن يحصل على تغطية شاملة...') is in scope; the rest of the post is already genuine Levantine and should stay untouched. The plain-text config block and the before/after table must survive byte-for-byte.

prompt: ظبطلي الملف هاد، في جملة شكلها AI بالنص، بس ما بدي السيو يتأثر — خليلي الكلمات المفتاحية والروابط زي ما هني.

mustPreserve: description: وصفات شامية بسيطة تقدر تحضرها بالبيت بدون تعقيد.
expected.notes: Edit mode + seo modifier: only the hedge-heavy MSA sentence under 'ليش نبلش بأكلات بسيطة' is in scope. Frontmatter, both internal links, the wp:paragraph comment, the image alt text, the JSON-LD block, and the three stated prep times must all survive unchanged; keyword 'أكلات شامية سهلة' must remain in title/first-100-words/an H2.
